title: The Shortest War in History: Just 38 Minutes
caption:
A whole war ended faster than your food delivery
A cartoon general yells 'fire the cannons!' as a white flag rises over the palace.
The Anglo-Zanzibar War of 1896 lasted only 38 minutes, the shortest war in history.
